_comment: Pose for the lv_terminal style. ALL LENGTHS ARE IN BLOCKS: 1.0 = one full block = 1 m = 1000 mm. offset / rotation / scale / origin / mirror move the MODEL; anchor moves only where a CABLE leaves the terminal. The two are independent on purpose - see docs/obj-model-manual.md.
_units: Write BLOCKS/METRES here. The project models in millimetres, so 500 mm of post = 0.5 in this file.
_scaleNote: scale is a plain multiplier: 1.0 = the size the OBJ was drawn at, 0.5 = half, 2.0 = double. It is NOT a unit conversion.
_anchorNote: anchor is measured from the MODEL ORIGIN (the OBJ's own 0,0,0, i.e. the foot of the post on the plate), in blocks/metres. (0,0,0) = model origin. x = right along the face, y = up along the face, z = out of the plate into the room. A wire 500 mm up the post is y: 0.5.
_objUnitsNote: objUnitsPerBlock is how many OBJ units make one block. This project models in MILLIMETRES, so it is 1000: 1000 mm = 1 m = 1 block. Only a legacy file drawn on the vanilla 0..16 block ruler would say 16. It does NOT affect the numbers above.
